title: neanotis prainiana
intro: Neanotis prainiana, commonly known as the Indian Sage, is a medicinal plant species belonging to the family Gentianaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, contributing to its therapeutic applications in treating various ailments such as fever, sore throat, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Neanotis prainiana include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include anti-oxidative, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial actions, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
